description: Defines an abstract base class 'BorderRendererBase' for rendering borders in RTF documents within the MigraDoc library. It includes methods for rendering individual borders, determining default colors, and managing border context (paragraph or cell).

classes.name: BorderRendererBase
classes.description: Abstract class providing border rendering functionalities for MigraDoc's RTF rendering, handling border styles, colors, widths, and context (paragraph or cell).

methods.name: RenderBorder
methods.description: Renders a single border with specified control, considering visibility, style, color, and width.

methods.name: GetDefaultColor
methods.description: Retrieves the default color for borders, using font color if available, otherwise black.

methods.name: GetBorderControl
methods.description: Returns the RTF control string for a given border type, considering whether it's a cell or paragraph border.
